# Copyright (c) 2026 agentctl contributors.
"""Private spawn observer exercising genuine Cabal initialization and vetoes."""

import json
import os
import sys
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path

from agentctl.bootstrap import build
from agentctl.check import haskell, haskell_mutants
from agentctl.check.audit import event_arguments
from agentctl.hostfacts import current
from agentctl.process import run
from agentctl.result import Err, Ok

mode, folder, project, outputs, cache, ghc, cabal, nonce = sys.argv[1:]
folder = Path(folder)
folder.mkdir(parents=True)
host = current(Path(cache))
home = folder / "home"
home.mkdir()
environment = dict(host.environment)
environment.update({"HOME": str(home), "USERPROFILE": str(home), **{
    f"XDG_{kind}_HOME": str(folder / kind.lower()) for kind in ("CACHE", "CONFIG", "DATA", "STATE")
}})
host = replace(host, home=home, environment=tuple(environment.items()))
context = build.BuildContext(Path(project), Path(outputs), host, build.Toolchain(ghc, cabal))
events = []
def observe(event, arguments):
    if event != "subprocess.Popen":
        return
    parsed = event_arguments(event, arguments)
    assert isinstance(parsed, Ok), parsed
    argv = parsed.value.argv
    name = Path(argv[0]).stem
    blocked = (
        mode == "index-init" and "update" in argv[1:]
        or mode == "suite-list" and "list-bin" in argv[1:]
        or mode == "suite-execute" and "test" in argv[1:]
        or mode == "mutant-execute" and name == "agentctl-core-test" and "--list-tests" not in argv[1:]
    )
    events.append({"nonce": nonce, "argv": list(argv), "blocked": blocked})
    if blocked:
        raise OSError("owned native boundary veto")
sys.addaudithook(observe)
control = run([sys.executable, "-c", "print('observer control')"], cwd=folder, env=environment)
assert isinstance(control, Ok) and control.value.code == 0
if mode == "index-init":
    context = replace(context, host=replace(host, cache=folder / "cache"))
    result = build.ensure_index(context)
    config = context.cabal_directory / "config"
    assert "url: https://hackage.haskell.org/" in config.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert not (context.cabal_directory / "agentctl-index-state").exists()
elif mode == "mutant-execute":
    result = haskell_mutants.selected_case(context, "haskell:agentctl-core-test/Handshake/protocol-fields", folder / "tasty.xml")
else:
    result = haskell.run_suites(context, folder / "reports", nonce)
assert isinstance(result, Err), result
assert "owned native boundary veto" in result.error.message
print(json.dumps({"nonce": nonce, "events": events, "refused": True}))
